subject: CAIQ: residency attestation and short runtime-sample for marketplace listing
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sanjay Patel <sanjay@neptunehealth.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-12-01T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: CAIQ: residency attestation and short runtime-sample for marketplace listing

Sanjay —

Thanks again for the quick sync this morning. As discussed, Neptune's marketplace listing process requires a filled CAIQ plus two supporting artifacts: a short runtime log sample showing token residency (date-limited) and a brief attestation that logging/retention practises meet the marketplace residency requirements.

High-level ask: please confirm whether a 7‑day runtime snapshot (UTC 2026‑11‑08 to 2026‑11‑15) and a signed attestation will satisfy your intake checklist. If the team needs a different window or additional metadata fields (tenant id obfuscation, sequence ID, request path), let me know.

Proposed timeline:
- We produce the runtime sample and attestation draft by EOD 2026‑12‑02
- Neptune does a short technical review and confirms acceptance by 2026‑12‑05

I’m looping in Jordan (marketplace lead) and Marissa (CS) to track the intake and handoff to compliance.

Thanks —
Aditya
Head of Sales Ops
Redwood Inference

Attachments: (none in this message)

From: Sanjay Patel <sanjay@neptunehealth.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-12-01T11:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: CAIQ: residency attestation and short runtime-sample for marketplace listing

Aditya —

Thanks for the clarity. The intake team is okay with a 7‑day window; two quick clarifications before we proceed:

1) Redaction: we require tenant identifiers to be pseudonymized (sha256-token or similar) in the sample.
2) Scope: include only request/response latency headers and residency tag (region code). No payloads.

If you can provide the snapshot in a zipped CSV with the columns: pseudonymized_tenant_id, timestamp_utc, region_code, request_path_stub, token_count, latency_ms that should be perfect.

Also please include a one‑paragraph attestation signed by Redwood legal or CISO that logs were captured and stored in the APAC region for the date range provided. A short DocuSign link is fine for signature.

If you can hit the 2026‑12‑02 timeline, I’ll escalate to the marketplace intake for faster review.

Regards,
Sanjay
Neptune Health — Marketplace Intake

On 2026-12-01 09:12, Aditya Rao wrote:
> Sanjay —
>
> Thanks again for the quick sync this morning. As discussed, Neptune's marketplace listing process requires a filled CAIQ plus two supporting artifacts...

From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwoodinference.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-12-01T12:30:00-08:00
Subject: FW: CAIQ: residency attestation and short runtime-sample for marketplace listing

Irene/Kim —

Looping you in. Neptune (external) has requested a 7‑day runtime snapshot (2026‑11‑08 to 2026‑11‑15) with tenant ids pseudonymized and a brief attestation that logs were captured and stored in APAC for that period. They want a CSV zipped up and a DocuSign for signature; timeline is tight (requested EOD 2026‑12‑02).

Concrete asks for security/compliance:
- Produce a sample export (csv) with columns: pseudonymized_tenant_id, timestamp_utc, region_code, request_path_stub, token_count, latency_ms
- Confirm redaction/pseudonymization approach (sha256 salt plan) and include a short note describing mechanism
- Draft a one‑paragraph attestation (CISO or delegated signatory) confirming residency and retention rules for the sample window
- Provide any supporting CAIQ control references that map this artifact to the relevant CSA controls (e.g., data residency / logging controls) — we’ll include in the CAIQ response.

Jordan/Marissa — will you track acceptance once security gives the package?

Appreciate the quick turnaround —
Aditya

From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwoodinference.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-12-02T08:45:00-08:00
Subject: Re: FW: CAIQ: residency attestation and short runtime-sample for marketplace listing

Aditya —

We can produce this. Quick summary of what we will deliver by EOD 2026‑12‑02: 

1) runtime-snapshot-20261115.zip (attachment) — zipped CSV with columns: pseudonymized_tenant_id, timestamp_utc, region_code, request_path_stub, token_count, latency_ms. Tenant pseudonymization uses sha256 with per‑export salt (note included in README inside zip). No payloads included.

2) caiq-attestation-template.docx (attachment) — draft one‑paragraph attestation for signature. Text preview: "Redwood Inference attests that log captures for the period 2026‑11‑08 to 2026‑11‑15 were stored within APAC region infrastructure in accordance with our data residency policy (Control ID: CSA‑DI‑2 / CSA‑LOG‑3). Logs were pseudonymized prior to export and access was limited to authorized compliance personnel."

3) Mapping notes (inline):
- CSA control CSA‑DI‑2 (Data Location) — mapping to attestation statement
- CSA‑LOG‑3 (Logging & Monitoring) — sample demonstrates retention & capture fields

We’ll add the README with hash algorithm and salt handling notes. I’ll attach the zip and the attestation doc to this thread and include a DocuSign link once Kimberly confirms the signatory.

Kimberly — please confirm signatory (CISO or Head of Compliance) and I’ll hand the doc to Legal for the signature envelope. Also adding JIRA SEC‑7421 to track the intake.

Thanks,
Irene Choi
Security Ops — Redwood Inference

Attachments referenced: runtime-snapshot-20261115.zip, caiq-attestation-template.docx

From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwoodinference.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-12-02T09:10:00-08:00
Subject: Re: FW: CAIQ: residency attestation and short runtime-sample for marketplace listing

Perfect — thank you, Irene.

Kimberly: please confirm who will sign (CISO or delegate). Jordan/Marissa: I’ll hand off to you after signature; if Neptune needs any follow‑up metadata fields we’ll include them in the README and reissue a tiny delta export.

Aditya
Head of Sales Ops
Redwood Inference
